```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
ggplot(iris, aes(x = Sepal.Width, y = Sepal.Length, color = Species)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Sepal Length vs. Sepal Width by Iris Species",
    x = "Sepal Width (cm)",
    y = "Sepal Length (cm)",
    color = "Species"
  )
```
